text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, my plan was a total success!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Everyone fell for my ruse and ended up
super
shocked! I felt like I was on top of
the world
there!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
choice_data_list: 次の作戦も練らないと
choice_data_list_en: We need to work out our next strategy too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wonder if I'll bag myself another easy
victory.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, if we're gonna be donning our
thinking
caps, we might as well wear
them while we do
some fishing
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and I'm not angling to slack off for
the sake
of slacking off here. I've gotta
do what I can to
make everyone
underestimate me, right? Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky chuckles, but I can't tell
whether she's
joking or not...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, yeah... But what kind to go with
next time?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, I'm getting excited just thinking
about
how dumbfounded everyone's
gonna be.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm really going to take their breath
away with my
next glorious scheme. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Seiun Sky has already
started
plotting her next win.
